import pathlib,shutil
P=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
for condition in ['candidate','baseline']:
 src=P/'runs'/('fullstack-'+condition)/'checkout'
 if not src.exists():continue
 dest=P/'human-preview'/condition;dest.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);(dest/'output').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 for name in ['store.py','server.py','app.js','index.html']:shutil.copyfile(src/name,dest/name)
 code=(src/'server.py').read_text();needle="        status,result=save(DB,self.headers.get('X-Trial-Actor','alice'),body.get('title'),body.get('revision'))"
 assert needle in code
 gate='''        if Path('output/pause-next').exists():
            import time
            Path('output/pause-next').unlink()
            Path('output/waiting').write_text('save paused before database effect')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+60
            while not Path('output/release').exists() and time.monotonic()<deadline:
                time.sleep(.02)
            if not Path('output/release').exists():return self.reply(503,{'error':'Controller gate timed out'})
            Path('output/release').unlink()
            Path('output/waiting').unlink()
'''
 (dest/'serve-preview.py').write_text(code.replace(needle,gate+needle))
 (dest/'README.md').write_text('''# Retained local integration preview

Synthetic data only. Captured frontend and store unchanged. server.py is the
captured immutable server. serve-preview.py adds only a controller file gate
before save for deterministic pending-edit testing; not part of the model artifact.
Both bind loopback and serve the editor/API, with local SQLite storage.

From this directory run:

    TRIAL_DB=output/preview.db PORT=0 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.13 serve-preview.py

The printed port is the actual local URL. Retain the candidate until human review
is complete; then stop only the recorded owned PID/session. Keep source/captures
needed for review before retiring this worktree. No automatic TTL or global prune.
''')
 print(condition,str(dest))
